name: Sylvester Turner
summary:
Sylvester Turner (September 27, 1954 – March 5, 2025) was an American politician and attorney who served as the U.S. representative for Texas's 18th congressional district from January 2025 until his death in March 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, Turner served as the 62nd mayor of Houston from 2016 to 2024 and as a member of the Texas House of Representatives from 1989 to 2016.
Born and raised in Houston, Turner graduated from the University of Houston with a bachelor's degree in political science and from  Harvard Law School with a Juris Doctor.
